p.n: Same meaning; 노트 is a loanword and sounds a bit more modern.

My pencil broke during the exam.
I sharpen my pencil.

I keep my own cup at the office.
I pour water into the cup.
I wash the cup.
This cup is a gift from my friend.

explain: 컵 안에 담은 음료는 “잔”으로 세요: 커피 한 잔. 컵 자체는 “개”로 세요: 컵 한 개.

explain_en: In speech people usually say 뭐. 무엇을 shortens to 뭘 and 무엇이 to 뭐가. 무엇 is more common in writing and presentations.
contract_en: shortened in speech: 무엇을 → 뭘, 무엇이 → 뭐가

dis.h: full form; formal, written or spoken

p.n: The replacement is the casual spoken contraction.
